boundaryNotes.CHN: Areas of the Kashmir dispute are shown as neutral context with dashed boundaries; they are not assigned to a claimant in this deck. The final status of Jammu and Kashmir has not been agreed upon by the parties.
boundaryNotes.CYP: The outline includes northern Cyprus and excludes the British Sovereign Base Areas of Akrotiri and Dhekelia.
boundaryNotes.ESH: The geographic territory of Western Sahara is shown in full, on both sides of the berm. The outline does not determine sovereignty.
